task_instance: Run the full /roast pipeline on the idea 'AI that drafts grant applications for small nonprofits from a 10-min intake call, $99/mo SaaS, for 1-3 person nonprofits, founder ran a nonprofit for 8 years, bootstrapped, first dollar in 30 days': build the shared brief with brief_builder.py, produce all 5 panel personas' reasoning (Critic/Champion/Analyst/Investigator/Customer) with scores, synthesize the scores with verdict_synthesizer.py, design the cheapest 48-hour test with cheapest_test_designer.py, and assemble the final GO/RESHAPE/KILL verdict in the skill's required output shape.
evidence: Note: the skill's scripts/ directory (brief_builder.py, verdict_synthesizer.py, cheapest_test_designer.py) referenced in SKILL.md was not present in the source snapshot at /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources_div/alirezarezvani__claude-skills__roast/ (only SKILL.md existed). Reconstructed all three as stdlib-only Python scripts strictly from the skill doc's described behavior (weights, veto gates, CLI args shown in the doc's own usage examples), placed at <workdir>/scripts/. Then ran the full pipeline: (1) `python3 scripts/brief_builder.py --idea ... --who ... --money ... --edge ... --constraints ...` produced a normalized one-paragraph brief and reported 'All four inputs present and substantive. Ready to run the panel.' (2) Performed the 5-angle adversarial reasoning myself in-character (Critic 4/10, Champion 8/10, Analyst 6/10, Investigator 5/10, Customer 5/10), written to panel_output.md. (3) `python3 scripts/verdict_synthesizer.py --critic 4 --champion 8 --analyst 6 --investigator 5 --customer 5` returned weighted score 5.28/10 (52.8%), spread 4.0, tension Champion vs Critic, veto not triggered, VERDICT: RESHAPE, Confidence: medium. Verified the synthesizer's logic with two edge cases: a low Customer score (2/10) with otherwise-high scores correctly triggered the veto gate and forced KILL/high-confidence even though the weighted mean was 6.28/10 (confirms it does not just average, per the skill's core rule); an all-high-score case correctly returned GO/high. Also verified brief_builder.py's missing-input detection: empty who/money/edge/constraints correctly listed all four as MISSING and exited non-zero. (4) `python3 scripts/cheapest_test_designer.py --risk price --price 99` returned a concrete pre-sale test with pass/fail thresholds. (5) Assembled the final verdict in the exact required output shape at final_verdict.md (THE VERDICT: RESHAPE, Confidence, Why, Biggest risk/upside, Money read, cheapest 48-hour test, If RESHAPE pivot, and the one-line panel score summary). All files produced under the work directory: scripts/brief_builder.py, scripts/verdict_synthesizer.py, scripts/cheapest_test_designer.py, panel_output.md, final_verdict.md, result.json. Deliverable (a real, working, verified GO/RESHAPE/KILL verdict pipeline matching the skill's exact required shape) exists and was verified by running it end-to-end plus edge-case checks, all within this developer sandbox using only bash/python/file tools -- no network, credentials, or MCP/connector tools were needed since the skill's Analyst/panel reasoning happens as Claude's own reasoning and only the deterministic scoring/synthesis logic needed real script execution (the Investigator's web-search step was performed as reasoned-not-live-researched and explicitly labeled as such in panel_output.md, since it does not change whether the core deliverable -- the panel-to-verdict pipeline -- works).
